example_prompt: In an automated test, mark the Cartflox test checkout session cmu8a1b2c0001xyz as paid without opening the payment page.

transactionId.description: Session identifier (`id` of the checkout session).

customerDetails.description: Optional customer details written on the transaction.

methodCode.description: Optional payment method code recorded in the metadata.

error_schema.description: Error shape of the payment page endpoints.

gotchas: Test sessions only: it settles the session SUCCESS or FAILED with provider: "sandbox" and sends the payment.completed or payment.failed webhook exactly as in production, with livemode: false.
No API key is needed: the session identifier is enough.
issue is French: succes marks the payment SUCCESS, echec marks it FAILED (default succes).
Refused with 403 for a production session of a live workspace, and 409 when the session is no longer payable (already SUCCESS, REFUNDED or CANCELLED).
Errors use the payment page shape { "success": false, "message": "..." }, not { "error" }.
Rate limit: 30 per minute per IP; beyond it the API answers 429.
